info.title: AuthKit
info.description: AuthKit's HTTP API on a default mount: the JSON API beneath /api/v1, browser OIDC beneath /oidc, JWKS at the issuer's path. Generated from the route catalog (internal/httpapi/catalog.go) by go generate ./internal/httpapi; do not edit.

ErrorObject.description: type follows the status; code is stable (clients tolerate new ones); message is not contract. metadata is null, or the shape x-authkit-error-codes gives the code.

OAuthError.description: The authorization server's protocol endpoints answer OAuth's own error object (RFC 6749 §5.2): error is the code, error_description is for people, and reason, when present, a stable cause beside the code.

SCIMError.description: The SCIM service provider answers SCIM's error (RFC 7644 §3.12) as application/scim+json: status is the HTTP status as a string, scimType a SCIM error type when one applies.
